dedupe_keys.name: production d electricite par filiere en temps reel

description: Production d'électricité par filière en temps réel is a dataset listed in data.corsica open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by EDF Corse. Le mix électrique de la Corse est publié en temps réel (mise à jour toutes les 15 minutes) grâce aux données issues de télémesures et d’estimations. Ces informations sont estimées, fournies à titre indicatif et pourraient contenir des erreurs. Coverage: Corsica. The portal files it under Environment & Energy. Its keywords are Production, Filière, Temps réel, Mix électrique. The portal shows 1,342 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2025-03-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-corsica-portal.
